codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that. Ask a workspace admin.
codes.NOT_FOUND: That no longer exists, or you do not have access to it.
codes.CONFLICT: That conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
codes.CSRF_REJECTED: The request came from another site and was refused. Reload the page.
codes.CAPTCHA_FAILED: The human check failed. Complete it and try again.
codes.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for a while; try again later or reset your password.
codes.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
codes.MFA_INVALID: That code is not valid. Check the time on your device and try again.
codes.SIGNUP_CLOSED: Sign-up is by invitation only. Ask a workspace admin to invite you.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
codes.TOKEN_INVALID: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
codes.MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Email is not set up on this installation. Ask the administrator to reset your password.
codes.LAST_OWNER: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
codes.INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
codes.ALREADY_MEMBER: That person is already a member of this workspace.
codes.CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Instagram is not set up on this installation. The administrator needs to add the Meta app keys.
codes.CHANNEL_IN_OTHER_WORKSPACE: That Instagram account is already connected to another workspace.
codes.CHANNEL_NEEDS_REAUTH: The account needs to be reconnected before it can be used.
codes.PROVIDER_ERROR: Instagram did not accept the request. Try again in a moment.
codes.MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED: Instagram only allows replies within 24 hours of the person's last message.
codes.BUFFER_INVALID_KEY: Buffer did not accept that API key. Copy it again from Buffer's settings.
codes.BUFFER_RATE_LIMITED: Buffer's request limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.

fields.invalid_url: Enter a full web address that starts with https://.
fields.invalid_code: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.
fields.keywords_required: Add at least one keyword, or choose to reply to every comment.
fields.public_reply_comment_only: Public replies are only possible on comments.
